description: This file implements debugging information handling for PyTorch's JIT mobile, including stack trace serialization, module hierarchy extraction, and debug info retrieval functions.

classes.name: MobileDebugTable
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and retrieving debug information, including source ranges and module hierarchy for PyTorch JIT mobile models.

methods.name: getModuleHierarchyInfo
methods.description: Returns the module hierarchy string for a given debug handle.

methods.name: getSourceDebugString
methods.description: Returns the source debug string for a given debug handle.

methods.name: getSourceDebugModuleHierarchyInfo
methods.description: Returns the debug info and module hierarchy string for a list of debug handles.
